items.name: Car park
items.where: 262 bays: 253 in the automated system and 9 conventional owner bays. Bays are rented, not sold with the home (except nine units).

items.name: Security
items.where: Car plate recognition, facial recognition at the lift lobbies, Desfire access cards, CCTV in the lift cars and parcel boxes outside the mailroom.

items.name: Lifts in three zones
items.where: 9 passenger lifts (3 per zone) plus a service and fire lift; all zones stop at the level 33 and 33A facilities.

items.name: Washrooms
items.where: Male and female washrooms on levels 33 and 33A; sauna and steam rooms on 63A.

items.name: 停车场
items.where: 262 个车位：253 个自动化车位及 9 个业主车位。车位以租用方式提供（9 个单位除外）。

items.name: 保安
items.where: 车牌识别、电梯大堂人脸识别、Desfire 门禁卡、电梯 CCTV，收发室外设包裹柜。

items.name: 三区电梯
items.where: 9 部客梯（每区 3 部）及 1 部服务兼消防梯；各区均停靠 33 与 33A 楼设施层。

items.name: 洗手间
items.where: 33 与 33A 楼设男女洗手间；63A 楼设桑拿与蒸汽室。
